name: Harsha Nandi
summary: Fourth-year B.Tech Computer Science student specialising in Data Science. I build web applications with Laravel and WordPress, and turn large datasets into predictive models and real-time dashboards with Python, SQL and Power BI.

Worked with cross-functional teams using Git — code reviews, debugging and production-ready delivery.

Analysed trends and patterns to surface actionable business opportunities.
